content: We used ADAM optimiser BIBREF17 with the learning rate 0.01 and $10^{-5}$ learning rate decay. We used categorical cross-entropy as a loss function and trained the model for 3 epochs. We present the results using the Macro $F_1$ score, that is the average of $F_1$-scores for each of the three NE classes (the class Other is excluded).
